title: payment.refund.requested
description: A command, not a fact-event (ADR-0034): orders-service instructs billing-service to refund a specific payment (RabbitMQ order.exchange). orderId is the only field -- billing-service already owns the authoritative transactionId/amount for this order's Payment, so relaying Orders' own copy of either would mean trusting a foreign echo of data billing-service is already the source of truth for.
